autostart.description: Whether Entangle should start automatically on system boot

image_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory where captured images are saved

device_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for camera communication before timing out

max_queue_size.description: Maximum number of queued capture requests before blocking further requests

camera_models.description: List of camera models Entangle should support; each defines hardware-specific settings

name.description: Friendly name for the camera model (e.g., 'Nikon D850')

baudrate.description: Serial communication speed in baud (e.g., 9600, 115200); required only for serial devices

trigger.timed_capture_interval.description: Seconds between automatic captures when timed_capture is enabled

trigger.external_trigger.description: Enable external trigger (e.g., via GPIO from physical shutter button)

trigger.external_trigger_pin.description: GPIO pin number (BCM numbering) to listen for external trigger signal

export.format.description: Image format to save after capture: 'raw', 'jpeg', or 'png'

export.quality.description: Compression quality for jpeg/png (0–100); higher = better quality, larger file

export.post_process_cmd.description: Optional shell command to run after each capture (e.g., 'cp $FILE /backup/')

export.delete_raw_after_export.description: Delete original RAW file after exporting processed version

web.bind.description: Network interface to bind the web UI to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only)

web.port.description: Port to serve the web interface on

web.enabled.description: Enable the built-in web control panel

web.auth_user.description: Username for basic auth on the web UI (leave blank to disable authentication)
